name: Evidence Photographs to County Agency
description: Photographs taken to preserve evidence of suspected abuse are sent to the county agency; the principal is notified when photos are taken.
deadline: at the time the written report is sent or within forty-eight (48) hours after an electronic report
quote: Any such photographs shall be sent to the county agency at the time the written report is sent or within forty-eight (48) hours after a report is made by electronic technologies or as soon thereafter as possible.
